name: Ransomware Idles the Fleet
description: Ransomware takes down dispatch, load planning, and ELD back-office systems; trucks sit or run on paper while systems are rebuilt.
asset: Dispatch, load planning, and fleet management systems
assumptions: Revenue loss counts idled capacity and missed pickup windows, not parked-asset value.
Manual dispatch sustains roughly half of normal load volume.
Secondary loss covers shipper contract penalties and lost lane awards.

name: Vendor Invoice Redirect Fraud
description: Fraudsters impersonate fuel, maintenance, or insurance vendors and redirect large recurring payments to attacker-controlled accounts.
asset: Accounts-payable process and vendor payment flows
assumptions: Large recurring fuel and insurance payments make convincing lures; attempts track vendor count.
Primary loss is the unrecovered diverted amount after bank clawback.
Secondary loss covers vendor relationship strain and audit remediation.

name: Telematics Platform Compromise
description: An attacker reaches the telematics and ELD platform, exposing fleet location history and risking tampered hours-of-service and remote vehicle commands.
asset: Telematics, ELD, and fleet location data
threat: Intruder via telematics vendor or stolen credentials
effect: Location data exposure and compliance risk
assumptions: Safety-critical remote commands are rate-limited by the vendor; the loss is data and compliance.
Primary loss covers investigation, device re-provisioning, and downtime for affected units.
Secondary loss covers FMCSA compliance exposure and customer-confidence damage.

name: Fictitious Pickup via Broker Account Takeover
description: Criminals take over load-board and broker accounts to book fictitious pickups, stealing high-value cargo with convincing paperwork.
threat: Organized cargo-theft ring using stolen broker credentials
assumptions: Attempts track posted high-value lanes; success requires defeating identity checks at booking.
Primary loss is cargo value net of insurance recovery and deductibles.
Secondary loss covers premium increases and shipper relationship fallout.

name: Shipment and Customer Data Breach
description: An intrusion into the TMS exposes customer contracts, rates, and shipment histories — commercially sensitive data competitors and thieves both value.
asset: Transportation management system and customer rate data
assumptions: Exposure is contract and rate data; little regulated personal data is held.
Primary loss covers forensics, containment, and customer notifications.
Secondary loss covers lost bids where leaked rates weaken negotiating position.
